title: Use of Broken MD5 Hash for Password Storage
description: Uses hashlib.md5 to hash passwords before storing in the database.
vulnerable_code:
import hashlib

def hash_user_password(password: str) -> str:
    # Vulnerable: Insecure MD5 hashing without salt
    digest = hashlib.md5(password.encode()).hexdigest()
    return digest

ground_truth.description: MD5 hash algorithm is cryptographically broken and vulnerable to collision and rainbow table attacks.
ground_truth.explanation: Passwords hashed with MD5 can be cracked in seconds; secure salted algorithms like Argon2 or bcrypt must be used (CWE-328, Bandit B303).

expected_evidence.description: Bandit B303 warning for insecure MD5 hash function.
